name: Radio Group
description: A framework-free Web Component that styles native radio inputs and reports the chosen value without taking over selection or keyboard behavior.

variants.name: Default
variants.description: A vertical group of options under a legend, showing the resting, checked, and focused states.

variants.name: Horizontal
variants.description: The same group laid out in a row that wraps onto more lines when space runs out.

variants.name: Descriptions
variants.description: Each option pairs its label with a line of supporting text that stays part of the accessible name.

variants.name: Cards
variants.description: Options rendered as selectable cards where the whole surface is the target, not only the dot.

variants.name: Validation
variants.description: A required group that reports an error message tied to the fieldset until a value is chosen.

variants.name: Restricted
variants.description: Individually unavailable options beside a group that is disabled as a whole.
